rule: One roll per site. Sites are blue-noise points on a 32-block z band, each with a seed from world seed and position. A site draws one value and walks the biome's model list; the first model whose chance beats the value wins, otherwise the value drops by that chance. Weights sum to at most 1, and the rest is an explicit empty share (the biome loader rescales only above 1). The winner is fitted to the terrain for its placement mode and rejected if the surface sits in another 32-block band; a rejected site stays empty. Shared tables carry their own chance, split by weight across their models, and join a biome only when the biome has every tag the table lists. Multi-block pieces are blueprint variants drawn by alias table, with child slots attached at direction-aligned rotations. Structures are applied in ascending priority so higher priority overwrites. Each generator salts the world seed with its own constant.
keep: One roll per site over a short weighted ladder
Explicit empty share when weights sum below 1
Site seed from world seed and position, so any server can regenerate it
Tag-gated shared tables (tables with no tags join every biome)
A salt per generator so seeds do not collide
Multi-block pieces as a root with child slots and alias-sampled variants
change: Seed the enumeration cells per cell, not per row (defect 1)
Replace the column-strip cell type with one roll per cell (defect 2)
Add a depth cap or load-time cycle check for child slots (defect 3)
Try the rest of the ladder when a rolled model fails terrain fit, or name the empty result (defect 4)
Flip or rename the table comparator (defect 5)
Model camps as socket roots with at most 3 attacker slots (MAX_ATTACKERS = 3)
look_test: Render one zone as a 375 px wide top-down strip with about 40 sites, in three weight sets: dense, sparse, and rare (landmark weight raised 10x). Dom checks a prop every few steps with no stacking, a landmark about once per long walk, and an empty patch that reads as a clearing. Pass if dense and sparse hold on all three. No release rows, no lock.
